- Luminate — $425k (contract review stalled; legal questions from their procurement)
- NovaCorp — $310k (PO delay; procurement requested SOC 2 sub-scope)

Yellow (watch):

Green (on track):
- MicronApps — $60k

Attachment: Q2_pipeline_snapshot.xlsx (xlsx, 145KB)
Related: HubSpot deal 67890 (link below).

If helpful, Marissa and Connor, let's carve 30 minutes Thursday to deep-dive Luminate. I can loop in Evelyn from Finance.

Thanks,
